mda.name: FCT Internal Revenue Service
mda.description: Federal Capital Territory Internal Revenue Service tax-administration services supported by the official FCT-IRS Service Level Agreement, FAQ, service pages and public notices. Tax liabilities are distinct from administrative service charges.

officialChannels.name: FCT-IRS official website
officialChannels.instructions: Use the official FCT-IRS website for tax-service information and official channels.

officialChannels.name: FCT-IRS taxpayer service phone
officialChannels.instructions: Official taxpayer-service contact listed in the FCT-IRS SLA.

officialChannels.name: FCT-IRS contact centre email
officialChannels.instructions: Official taxpayer-service email listed by FCT-IRS.

fctirs-sla-v1.title: FCT-IRS Service Level Agreement (SLA) Version 1.0
fctirs-sla-v1.documentReference: FCT-IRS Service Level Agreement — service table, PDF pages 1–6
fctirs-sla-v1.notes: Official FCT-IRS SLA listing five services, timelines, costs and requirements. The document does not state a provider publication/effective date, so FeeLens must not substitute its access or review date as the provider date.

fctirs-faq.title: FCT-IRS Official FAQ
fctirs-faq.documentReference: FAQ sections on TIN registration, TIN fee, TIN retrieval, tax returns and TCC
fctirs-faq.notes: Official FAQ states that TIN generation is free, provides individual and non-individual registration routes, explains TIN retrieval, tax-return filing and TCC application/verification.

fctirs-free-service-notice.title: FCT-IRS free-service and anti-gratification notice
fctirs-free-service-notice.documentReference: Official notice on processing fees and service charges
fctirs-free-service-notice.notes: FCT-IRS states that its services are rendered free of charge and that offering or accepting processing/service charges is not allowed. This supports FCT-IRS administrative service-charge claims; it does not mean underlying tax liabilities or third-party telecom/payment-provider charges are zero.

fctirs-tax-id-2026-notice.title: Nigerian Tax ID Portal Goes Live Effective January 1, 2026
fctirs-tax-id-2026-notice.documentReference: FCT-IRS public notice on Nigerian Tax ID transition
fctirs-tax-id-2026-notice.notes: Official FCT-IRS notice states that use of the Nigerian Tax ID became effective 1 January 2026 and replaces previously issued TINs. Historical SLA and FAQ wording is retained where necessary for evidence traceability.

fctirs-tax-return-process.title: Filing Tax Return — FCT-IRS
fctirs-tax-return-process.notes: Official FCT-IRS page describing the self-service tax-return filing process.

fctirs-tcc-checklist.title: FCT-IRS Tax Clearance Certificate Checklist
fctirs-tcc-checklist.notes: Official FCT-IRS checklist describing PAYE TCC prerequisites and applicant documents.

services.name: TIN generation / enrolment
services.description: Registration/enrolment for a taxpayer identification record. FCT-IRS historical sources use the term TIN; FCT-IRS subsequently announced the Nigerian Tax ID transition effective 1 January 2026.
requirements: Duly completed taxpayer registration information.
Bank Verification Number (BVN) where applicable.
National Identification Number (NIN) where applicable.
Corporate/non-individual applicants provide the required business registration information.
processSteps: Use the official FCT-IRS/JTB registration route.
Provide the required taxpayer identification information.
Complete and submit the registration request.
Retain the issued Tax ID/TIN record through the official channel.
services.notes: The SLA expressly lists Taxpayer Identification Number Enrolment as Free. The FCT-IRS FAQ independently states that TIN generation is free of charge. The 2026 Tax ID terminology transition should be shown as a current-context note, not used to rewrite historical source wording.
services.paymentGuide: FCT-IRS administrative service charge: Free. Do not pay an unofficial processing fee.

feeOptions.label: TIN generation / enrolment
feeOptions.notes: Free according to the FCT-IRS SLA and official FAQ.
feeOptions.page: SLA service 1; FAQ — How much do I pay for TIN?
feeOptions.evidenceNote: SLA lists enrolment as Free; FAQ states TIN generation is free.

services.name: TIN retrieval
services.description: Retrieval or lookup of an existing taxpayer identification record using the official FCT-IRS/JTB process.
requirements: Use the registered phone number where applicable.
Follow the identity information requested by the official retrieval route.
processSteps: Follow the FCT-IRS FAQ retrieval instructions or official Tax ID/TIN lookup route.
Provide the requested identity information.
Retrieve or confirm the taxpayer identifier through the official channel.
services.notes: The FAQ establishes the retrieval process but does not separately state a retrieval price. The FCT-IRS free-service notice supports a zero FCT-IRS processing/service charge. Possible telecom, SMS, USSD or network-provider charges are not established by the reviewed evidence.
services.paymentGuide: FCT-IRS processing/service charge: Free based on the general free-service notice. This does not establish third-party telecom or network charges.

feeOptions.label: TIN retrieval — FCT-IRS service charge
feeOptions.conditions: Applies only to the FCT-IRS administrative processing/service charge.
feeOptions.notes: Telecom, SMS, USSD or network-provider charges are outside this verified claim.
feeOptions.page: Official free-service notice; FAQ — lost TIN retrieval
feeOptions.evidenceNote: FAQ supports the retrieval process; the separate FCT-IRS notice supports the administrative service-charge claim.

services.name: Processing of filed annual tax returns
services.description: FCT-IRS processing of an individual's filed annual tax return after submission of the required return and supporting evidence.
requirements: Duly completed Form A.
Evidence of tax deductions for individuals in employment.
Evidence of payment of assessed tax for individuals in business where applicable.
Statement of income for the preceding year.
Evidence of benefits in kind where applicable.
Evidence of allowable deductions such as relevant pension, NHIS, gratuity or life-insurance items where applicable.
processSteps: Access the official FCT-IRS self-service tax-return workflow.
Complete and submit the required annual return.
Provide supporting tax and income information.
FCT-IRS processes the filed annual return.
services.notes: The administrative processing service is listed as Free. Any tax liability arising from an assessment is separate from the administrative service fee.
services.paymentGuide: Administrative processing service: Free. Tax assessed or payable is not a service fee and must not be represented as zero.

feeOptions.label: Annual tax return processing
feeOptions.notes: Does not represent or waive any underlying tax liability.
feeOptions.evidenceNote: SLA lists processing of filed annual tax returns as Free with a 72-hour service standard.

services.name: Tax Clearance Certificate issuance — PAYE employee
services.description: Application and issuance of a Tax Clearance Certificate for an individual taxed under the Pay As You Earn scheme.
requirements: Employer annual declaration/certificate and remittance evidence as applicable.
Evidence of allowable deductions claimed.
FCT-IRS taxpayer identification record.
Completed Personal Income Tax Annual Returns Form A.
Completed TCC application form.
Valid means of identification.
Relevant payslips or bank statement where applicable.
Previous TCC for renewal where applicable.
processSteps: Ensure the applicable employer and taxpayer filings are up to date.
Complete the FCT-IRS TCC application requirements.
Submit through the applicable official FCT-IRS channel.
FCT-IRS performs the required tax-compliance checks and issues or declines the certificate.
services.processingStandard: Maximum 14 days in the FCT-IRS SLA and FAQ.
services.notes: The TCC issuance service is free. The applicant may still have outstanding tax liabilities that must be satisfied before a TCC can be issued.
services.paymentGuide: TCC issuance service charge: Free. This does not mean outstanding taxes are waived.

feeOptions.label: PAYE Tax Clearance Certificate issuance
feeOptions.notes: Underlying tax compliance and liabilities remain separate.
feeOptions.evidenceNote: SLA lists PAYE TCC issuance as Free with a 14-day service standard.

services.name: Tax Clearance Certificate issuance — individual in business / partnership
services.description: Application and issuance of a Tax Clearance Certificate for an individual in business or a partnership.
requirements: FCT-IRS taxpayer identification record.
Completed Personal Income Tax Annual Returns Form A.
Completed enterprise/business TCC application form where applicable.
Valid means of identification.
Previous TCC or evidence of income tax for the relevant previous years.
Signed/stamped statement of accounts where applicable.
Bank statements for relevant years where required.
Other relevant supporting documents requested by FCT-IRS.
processSteps: Complete the applicable annual tax filings and TCC application documentation.
Provide business/partnership financial and tax evidence.
Submit through the applicable official FCT-IRS channel.
FCT-IRS performs the required tax-compliance checks and issues or declines the certificate.
services.notes: The administrative TCC issuance service is free. The record does not state that tax due, assessed tax or other lawful liabilities are free.
services.paymentGuide: TCC issuance service charge: Free. Tax liabilities remain separate.

feeOptions.label: Business / partnership Tax Clearance Certificate issuance
feeOptions.notes: Underlying tax liabilities and assessments remain separate.
feeOptions.evidenceNote: SLA lists TCC issuance for individuals in business and partnerships as Free with a 14-day service standard.

services.name: Tax Clearance Certificate verification
services.description: Verification of the authenticity of an FCT-IRS Tax Clearance Certificate.
requirements: Written verification request where required.
Provide sufficient details of the certificate to be verified.
processSteps: Use the official FCT-IRS verification procedure or submit the required written request.
Provide the TCC details requested by FCT-IRS.
Receive confirmation of authenticity through the official process.
services.notes: The SLA expressly lists TCC verification as Free.
services.paymentGuide: FCT-IRS TCC verification service charge: Free.

feeOptions.label: Tax Clearance Certificate verification
feeOptions.notes: Official SLA service charge is Free.
feeOptions.evidenceNote: SLA lists TCC verification as Free with a 48-hour service standard.
